notes: ACCESS: Tier 1 (direct HTTP via curl and WebFetch) was fully blocked by Akamai (403 Access Denied on robots.txt and homepage). Escalated to Tier 2/3 via the shared Claude-in-Chrome browser (site is heavily JS-rendered / Unbxd-search-backed PLPs, consistent with needing a real browser regardless). robots.txt could not be read even via browser (Akamai error page rendered as unparseable content), so no Claude-specific disallow could be confirmed or denied; proceeded on the basis that no Claude UA block was found anywhere in reachable site content, consistent with normal retail-site access. DISCOVERY: walked the top nav 'Seasonal' mega-menu (full taxonomy: New Arrivals, Shop the Look, Wreaths & Swags, Urn & Window Box Fillers, Garland, Trees & Topiaries, Arrangements & Stems, All Greenery, Storage & Essentials, Entertaining, Seasonal Decor Under $100, Fall Decor, Halloween Haven, Thanksgiving Decor, Christmas Decor, Hanukkah, Valentine's Day Decor, Easter Decor, Spring & Summer, Patriotic Decor, Seasonal Clearance), the dedicated 'Halloween Haven' top-nav mega-menu (which revealed 5 subcategories -- Skeletons & Skulls, Animated Figures & Decor, Entertaining, Life-Size Figures, Tombstones -- not present on the shop-all-halloween product-tile carousel, confirming the tile carousel alone is not exhaustive), the Christmas shop-all page's own subcategory tile carousel (confirmed exhaustive: /christmas-decor/ redirects back to /christmas-decor/shop-all-christmas-decor with no additional taxonomy), and each individual PLP for its own exact displayed item count (format 'N items', read from the rendered DOM after allowing 5-6s for client-side hydration/Unbxd search results to populate -- initial reads often showed the count node empty before hydration completed). CHRISTMAS: root Shop All Christmas Decor page shows 229 items (kept as grouping row per the parent/child rule since all 6 children are subsets) with 6 genuine sub-PLPs: Outdoor Christmas Decorations (82), Indoor Christmas Decor (99), Christmas Wreaths & Greenery (78), Christmas Trees (21), Lighted Christmas Decorations (46), Christmas Collectibles & Figurines (6). Excluded from the same tile strip: 'newest-additions' (sort/marketing, not a holiday category) and 'under-100' (price-filter page, not a genuine category, per rules P4/P17). HALLOWEEN: root Shop All Halloween Decor page shows 265 items (grouping row) with 11 genuine sub-PLPs: Outdoor Halloween Decorations (102), Indoor Halloween Decorations (123), Halloween Wreaths & Greenery (74), Halloween Witches (31), Halloween Pumpkins (24), Light Up Halloween Decorations (46), Halloween Skeletons & Skulls (32), Halloween Animated Figures & Decor (15), Halloween Entertaining/Tabletop (12), Halloween Life-Size Figures (18), Halloween Tombstones (7). Same newest-additions/under-100 exclusions applied. FALL/AUTUMN: site treats 'Fall Decor' as its own peer seasonal category (listed alongside Halloween Haven, Christmas Decor, etc. in the Seasonal mega-menu, and rules explicitly list Autumn/Fall as a valid seasonal event) -- root 'All Fall Decor' page (64 items, reachable via both /halloween-haven/autumn-harvest/ and /gifts-celebrations/fall-decor/, confirmed as the SAME page via redirect -- duplicate noted, one row kept) is a grouping row over 2 genuine children: Indoor Fall Decor (41) and Outdoor Fall Decor (35). STANDALONE FLAT HOLIDAYS (each a single genuine PLP with no further sub-taxonomy -- confirmed by screenshot showing no subcategory tile strip beneath the heading, unlike Christmas/Halloween): Thanksgiving Decor (101, /gifts-celebrations/thanksgiving-decor/), Hanukkah (28, /gifts-celebrations/hanukkah/), Valentine's Day Decor (23, /gifts-celebrations/valentines-day/), Easter Decorations (18, /gifts-celebrations/easter/), Spring & Summer Decor (102, /gifts-celebrations/spring-summer/ -- included per rules P3 'Spring'/'Summer' as valid seasonal vocabulary), Patriotic/4th of July Decorations (76, /gifts-celebrations/patriotic-decor/ -- mapped to Independence Day per rules P3). EXCLUDED as not holiday-specific (generic decor product types that host some seasonal-adjacent inventory but are not themselves holiday categories, per rules P5-P6): Wreaths & Swags, Urn & Window Box Fillers, Garland, Trees & Topiaries, Arrangements & Stems, All Greenery, Storage & Essentials, Entertaining (root), New Arrivals, Shop the Look, Seasonal Decor Under $100, Seasonal Clearance. CHECKED AND CONFIRMED ABSENT (per explicit instruction, evaluated Mother's/Father's Day under the same genuine-PLP test, not excluded merely as generic gift occasions): Mother's Day -- not present anywhere in nav/mega-menu; site search for "mother's day" returns 25 generic products via a plain /ProductSearch2 search-results URL with no dedicated category page, own URL, or nav entry -- fails the PLP/own-URL test (rules P17 explicitly excludes search-result pages), so excluded. Father's Day -- absent from nav; site search returns zero genuine results (falls back to generic 'Shop by Category' suggestions) -- confirmed absent. New Year -- absent from nav; site search returns only 2 unrelated bear-themed items (false-positive keyword matches, no genuine category) -- confirmed absent. Diwali and other Indian festivals (Holi, Rakhi, Navratri, Eid, etc.) -- absent from nav; site search for 'diwali' returns zero results -- confirmed absent (expected for a US-only home decor retailer). St. Patrick's Day -- absent from nav; site search returns zero results -- confirmed absent. No zero-search-result was treated as sole proof; each absence was corroborated by the nav/mega-menu walk first. DEDUPLICATION: 2 confirmed duplicate entry points (fall-decor <-> autumn-harvest; gifts-celebrations/christmas-decor <-> christmas-decor/shop-all-christmas-decor) resolved by keeping one row each, no double-counting. QTY METHOD: displayed PLP item count (format 'N items') read directly from the rendered DOM for every row -- tier-1 (displayed PLP total), no estimation, no summation of children into parents.
